incidents.summary: Harness-owned text files could be overwritten or appended to directly outside their native writers.
incidents.expected: Native writers atomically publish complete harness-owned files without write bits, preventing accidental direct overwrite and append while native updates and locked appends continue. Readers accept writable old files and record-check copies. This is accidental direct-write protection only: the same user can still chmod, unlink or replace a file through its writable directory. Full H15 closure requires host-enforced read-only access with a separately authorized writer, which this repository does not establish. The shell-reading guards stay in place.

incidents.expected: Preparation and contribution gates require supported development before publication; outcome quality remains unmeasured by this incident.

incidents.summary: The cohort skill promised paper enumeration that its command did not perform.

incidents.summary: Status copied a large research inventory into an unbounded report.

incidents.summary: Repeated manuscript reviews improved soundness while contribution stayed below acceptance.

incidents.summary: The status summary exceeded its size bound by listing every challenge criterion.

incidents.summary: Unavailable sources prevented an honest source-limited manuscript from progressing.

incidents.summary: A child assessment could not refresh the parent checkpoint pinned by its immutable plan.

incidents.summary: Small mutations repeatedly validated the complete growing store.

incidents.summary: A skill example omitted structured authors and produced author mismatches.

incidents.summary: Round export and round-review used different representations of the same evidence.

incidents.summary: A user-authorized deposit could not move the study into the deposit stage.

incidents.summary: Citation checks selected preprint metadata and counted bibliography entries the manuscript never cited.

incidents.summary: A format-only rerun was refused by the ordinary closed-strategy rule.

incidents.summary: Bar continuations replayed all previous full texts until Codex rejected the input.

incidents.summary: A contaminated completed attempt blocked both resampling and context repair.

incidents.summary: Openness export accepted search declarations that its recording audit later rejected.

incidents.summary: Duplicated evidence and history metadata left result packets above the text-route limit.

incidents.summary: Coverage and citation checks credited saved evidence that the actual request withheld.

incidents.summary: The probe CLI refused a valid workspace created by problem-init.

incidents.summary: Pending HTML visual diagnostics hid a complete PDF capture of the same work.

incidents.summary: Review construction rejected a PDF served under a generic binary media type.

incidents.summary: A completed reviewer answer with one surplus brace was discarded.

incidents.summary: A standalone producer could not accept a proof of its own distinct claim.

incidents.summary: A native strategy prompt demanded proof of the original result during planning review.

incidents.summary: CLI trimming of one terminal instruction space made completed reviews unverified.

incidents.summary: A reviewer supplied structured coverage where the native contract expected scalar text.

incidents.summary: Openness export could not deliver a supporting native proof and its observed review.

incidents.summary: An openness input repeated large alternate HTML bodies and proof-contained sources.

incidents.summary: A context repair could not confirm a qualified objection delivered only in historical evidence.

incidents.summary: An objection identity conflict escaped the output validator and permanently occupied its slot.

incidents.summary: Older readers silently merged qualified objections written by a newer local repair.
incidents.expected: A compatible pinned reader is required to retain qualified identities; an older reader is not certified safe and runtime compatibility remains a prerequisite.

incidents.summary: An openness reviewer could not inspect a retained publisher preview.
incidents.expected: source_evidence delivers the complete captured response and honest provenance; it grants neither a full reading nor scientific support by itself.

incidents.summary: JSON serialization left a protected openness input above the Codex limit.
incidents.expected: The framed route measures its actual representation and preserves protected bodies; a fitting request dispatches under its own pinned adapter identity.

incidents.summary: A source continuation replayed metadata and too many full texts for the route.
incidents.expected: Whole source groups are admitted in fitting batches with explicit deferred requests; exact-text encoding preserves logical input and continuation remains pending until delivery completes.

incidents.summary: A later reviewer turn lost decisive full texts supplied in earlier batches.
incidents.expected: complete-visible delivery closes over the exact requested bodies and inherits its mode; later acquisition does not change already recorded requests or authentication.

incidents.summary: Repeated runtime version checks dominated assignment evaluation cost.
incidents.expected: An evaluation reuses pure derivations while each public call observes current adapter runtimes; unchanged views remain equal without a cross-command cache.

incidents.summary: An oversized openness export gave no warning that text priority was needed.
incidents.expected: Export reports review_input_too_large diagnostics and route ids before dispatch; the oversized packet remains an explicit warning or refusal until delivery is planned.

incidents.expected: A reference without a digest resolves only to the exact carried version; missing evidence produces a typed refusal without consulting current records or crashing.

incidents.summary: A focused adjudicator did not receive a newly supplied comparator source.
incidents.expected: The actual focused request includes the complete current source and its delivery manifest; its current citation records successfully and unrelated corrections remain refused.

incidents.summary: The result prompt's no-stop example incorrectly used an incomplete assurance status.
incidents.expected: The current example marks a completed no-stop check passed; historical prompt identities remain valid and actual incomplete assurances still block posting.

incidents.summary: Result coverage credited binary evidence present only in the saved packet.

incidents.summary: A completed review had no refresh reason for a superseded prompt contract.
incidents.expected: One prompt_contract_changed continuation retains the original slot, exact old output and history; a duplicate continuation is refused as a fork or forbidden resampling.

incidents.summary: Text-only result inputs omitted required visual inspections of PDF pages.
incidents.expected: A visual-capable route binds required page images to the actual request; missing pages keep visual evidence unassessed rather than receiving delivery credit.

incidents.summary: Codex consumed the trailing stdin marker as another image filename.
incidents.expected: The visual CLI command terminates image arguments before stdin; valid image delivery launches with the intended files and input stream.

incidents.summary: A visual route probe mistook textual placeholders for image control values.
incidents.expected: The probe identifies control images by numeric position and requires exact image-read codes; the route remains unverified unless its positive controls pass.

incidents.summary: A verified obstruction could not bind the producer's own strategy target.
incidents.expected: A reviewed obstruction of the target meets verified_strategy_obstruction; the target obligation and root proof remain open without false proof credit.

incidents.summary: The hook interpreted a long free-text task argument containing a slash as a filesystem path.
incidents.expected: Managed task text is not probed as a path; the valid command passes without ENAMETOOLONG recovery while real managed paths remain guarded.

incidents.summary: A native proposal review with a string reviewer field was marked completed without a contract check.
incidents.expected: Run-time validation records invalid_native_review at native.output and retains the refusal; one valid retry completes the assignment and can bind its review.

incidents.summary: A URL-only work lacked a bundle locator and produced a late post obligation.
incidents.expected: Append-only HTTPS locator provenance binds the exact version, original bytes and existing reading without changing historical unit digests or granting credit to stale readings.

incidents.summary: Bound search response bodies made result packets exceed the route limit.
incidents.expected: Fitting elides search response bodies largest first with explicit omission metadata; retained current evidence remains intact and the bounded request is deterministic.

incidents.summary: A refresh could withhold more evidence bodies than necessary.
incidents.expected: A prospective assignment records a restoration policy that gives back exact current text bodies in packet order only when the fully encoded route request fits; historical requests and retry bytes remain unchanged and withheld content earns no delivery credit. record-check and the record fingerprint rebuild a restored request under its recorded policy.

incidents.summary: A retry rebuilt a different request after the fitting order changed.
incidents.expected: Request reconstruction tries the recorded fit order and retains the original request bytes; retry authentication does not silently adopt the current order.

incidents.summary: A repair with two refused outputs prevented a replacement repair from continuing its slot.
incidents.expected: An eligible new repair can continue the exhausted repair's original slot; historical attempts and their two refusals remain recorded.

incidents.summary: Large full-text bodies prevented focused adjudication from fitting its route.

incidents.summary: Reviewers copied malformed digests and mismatched record kinds from large inputs.
incidents.expected: Kind-and-id references bind to the delivered record version when uniquely justified; wrong kinds, ambiguous versions and changed objection claims remain typed refusals.

incidents.summary: Fenced answers and a thinking_tokens system event made valid Claude probes fail.

incidents.summary: A later route probe changed the origin used to authenticate an existing bridge.
incidents.expected: Bridge authentication uses probes preceding its child assignment; later probes do not rewrite provenance, while a current failed probe still disqualifies new use.

incidents.summary: A release note claimed that every inline formula stayed on one line.
incidents.expected: A dated release-note correction states the actual inline-formula limitation; documentation is corrected without changing already published records.

incidents.summary: A plugin update deleted files still used by a running review session's hooks.
incidents.expected: Each generated hook command finds its entrypoint missing: a blocking hook refuses with the update message, a non-blocking hook reports it, and the Stop hook lets the session stop; the session restarts to load the new version (owner decision of 0.62.0).

incidents.summary: CI lacked the pdftoppm executable required by native PDF image tests.
incidents.expected: The CI environment installs poppler-utils before visual tests; a missing local executable remains an explicit runtime dependency refusal.

incidents.summary: A failed nested fixture setup left a stub module installed for later tests.
incidents.expected: Cleanup is registered before nested setup; fixture failure restores the module environment and unrelated tests import the real implementation.

incidents.summary: A third-party APT repository returned HTTP 403 and stopped CI setup.
incidents.expected: CI dependency installation uses the Ubuntu archive sources it needs; unrelated third-party repository failure no longer blocks setup.

incidents.summary: Lifecycle tests gave a new interpreter too little startup time under load.
incidents.expected: Test supervision waits for explicit startup evidence within an appropriate deadline; successful jobs reconcile once without timing-dependent duplicate work.

incidents.summary: Code merged before release steps finished and the release lacked its published record.
incidents.expected: The release procedure checks tags, GitHub release records and branch activation at release time; missing release records are completed before acceptance.

incidents.summary: A CLI update made old assignments unverified against the installed runtime.
incidents.expected: Context authentication uses the route's retained runtime pin; historical attempts remain valid while changed pinned evidence is rejected.

incidents.summary: A bar repair made after the statement was excluded from result input ancestry.
incidents.expected: Ancestry accepts the compatible null-statement predecessor subject; result coverage includes the repaired bar's authenticated actual input.

incidents.summary: A lost-worker test raced with the watchdog's ownership lock.
incidents.expected: The test waits until no process-group member remains before taking the lock; replay returns the interrupted result and releases reserved experiment time.

incidents.summary: Release tests still expected the preceding plugin version.
incidents.expected: Manifest and Codex version assertions track the released version; the release validation completes with consistent pins.

incidents.summary: Darwin process enumeration returned zero with errno and was mistaken for an empty group.
incidents.expected: Enumeration raises the underlying OSError when libproc sets errno; cleanup cannot classify a failed lookup as an empty process group.

incidents.summary: The post gate required search response bodies that text-route fitting intentionally elided.
incidents.expected: Bound search records establish their declared coverage even when response bodies are elided; no separate citation credit is granted for an undelivered body.

incidents.summary: Recursing into a repeated-part placeholder crashed assignment-state evaluation.
incidents.expected: Qualified objection collection ignores repeated placeholders at every supported history path; status and next classify the review without an AttributeError.

incidents.summary: Moving a record left a registered absolute root that made hooks refuse all tools.
incidents.expected: General record relocation remains unsupported; qualification uses clone-local read-only search status and next without packet verification, while ordinary moved-root sessions still refuse.

incidents.class: upgrade (recorded grades under a new rubric)
incidents.summary: A grade recorded before a new admission item lost its threshold checks after posting.
incidents.expected: Legacy grades retain their applicable threshold findings; a recorded post remains terminal and later findings appear only as advisory after_post information.

incidents.summary: Admission skipped workspace initialization when research files already existed.
incidents.expected: Admission creates only missing skeleton items and preserves existing research files; nonempty unadopted journals refuse with adoption_required before mutation.

incidents.summary: A reviewer appended an unmarked correction and another JSON object after a malformed answer.
incidents.expected: Unmarked multiple-answer text remains refused; only the explicit supported retraction contract selects a replacement answer, preserving the original response evidence.

incidents.summary: The complete math-solver openness minimum exceeded the review route input limit.
incidents.expected: A reading chain delivers the objective-sized minimum in bounded turns; accepted final coverage audits every required unit without inventing reading credit.

incidents.summary: Finishing an unrelated node made another already observed proposal review appear stale.
incidents.expected: Protected packet content stays exact while allowed unrelated context drift is recorded; interrupted binding resumes idempotently and historical review bytes remain unchanged.

incidents.summary: Consumers disagreed on generic binary media spellings and their PDF delivery.
incidents.expected: Media normalization and historical projection apply each admitted contract consistently; supported PDF attachments are credited and unsupported historical text delivery remains omitted.

incidents.summary: Old requests delivered a generic-binary PDF as text that newer projection treated as omitted.
incidents.expected: The documented historical limitation remains: PDF delivery requires exact native attachment bytes, and affected old text-only evidence remains unassessed.

incidents.summary: A harmless Claude ui_invalidate event made otherwise valid reviews unverified.
incidents.expected: Exact audited UI notices are retained without contaminating context; altered payloads or additional context issues still fail verification and historical evidence stays authenticated.

incidents.summary: Root finalization hid an already allocated standalone node from the scheduler.
incidents.expected: The allocated side interval schedules execute_node before root finalization; accepting root support does not prevent the admitted side work from running.

incidents.summary: Read-only inspection by another session appended activity and displaced useful entries.
incidents.expected: The activity hook recognizes read-only inspection and preserves the harness session; wc inspection does not append a writing activity.

incidents.summary: Lab lifecycle tests timed out under load while a separate Lean smoke failure remained undiagnosed.
incidents.expected: The 0.73.0 lab-test repair replaces the two-second startup assumption with observable lifecycle progress and isolated deadlines, with its new tests still pending; the Lean smoke failure remains undiagnosed, so the combined catalog incident stays open and is not certified closed by lab coverage alone.

incidents.summary: A PDF title injected a Pages line that was selected as the real page count.
incidents.expected: Ambiguous pdfinfo page counts classify the PDF as malformed_pdf; no extracted text or invented page map is accepted.

incidents.summary: A quoted SVG data URI was misread as a page-relative image URL.
incidents.expected: CSS resource discovery ignores the inline data URI and retains actual image URLs; unsupported document styling remains an explicit partial-visual diagnostic.

incidents.summary: A format-only conversion reopened a closed cycle for ordinary execution.
incidents.expected: Format-only admission and recording preserve the original closed-cycle state; later ordinary admission remains refused.

incidents.summary: Restore overwrote an edit made after its last comparison without retaining a backup.
incidents.expected: Restore first displaces the current file atomically and records its exact backup bytes; the pinned bytes are restored without losing the late edit.

incidents.summary: Case and Unicode aliases made pinned restore destinations overwrite each other.
incidents.expected: Restore refuses conflicting normalized destinations with publication_artifact_invalid before any write; working files and artifacts remain unchanged.

incidents.summary: A missing or corrupt pinned artifact crashed status and obligation reporting.
incidents.expected: Status survives the missing pin without claiming a clean drift result; explicit restore still refuses with artifact_missing or artifact_corrupt.

incidents.summary: An unresolved JATS entity silently removed a graphic attribute while extraction succeeded.
incidents.expected: Unresolved text, attribute or parameter entities classify extraction as xml_external_entity; no silently incomplete article is accepted as extracted.

incidents.summary: Graphic deduplication and publication drift checks scaled poorly on large inputs.
incidents.expected: Graphic names use bounded set-based deduplication and drift checks hash bounded streams after checking size; parity is retained without quadratic scans or whole-file buffering.

incidents.summary: Validation parsed identical malformed JSON and checked evidence before missing claim mappings.
incidents.expected: Missing claim mappings refuse first, and byte-identical format-only outputs need no JSON parse; changed malformed bytes still refuse format_only_output_mismatch.

incidents.summary: Redundant CI triggers and split release files left releases queued or misversioned.
incidents.expected: The workflow limits push triggers and release integration keeps metadata synchronized; CI and release records remain required acceptance steps.

incidents.summary: Python equality treated booleans and numeric JSON values as interchangeable in review packets.
incidents.expected: Canonical JSON comparison preserves exact types on initial binding and rebinding; changed protected context refuses without altering prior reviews.

incidents.summary: A disabled Codex exec attempt made a clean reviewer rollout unverified.
incidents.expected: The audited disabled-exec rollout is retained as a notice across Codex routes; usable output verifies only when all remaining context checks pass.

incidents.summary: Two tests relied on a local Codex executable and an implicit tests import path.
incidents.expected: Fixtures provide their pinned runtime evidence and subprocess scripts explicitly bind their import roots; test execution no longer requires the developer's local CLI or PYTHONPATH.

incidents.summary: The guard refused a writing command that named the discovery pointer only as a source.
incidents.expected: A literal cp reads the discovery pointer as a source and checks only its destination for writes; reverse copies, moves, deletes, ambiguous forms, symlink destinations and mixed write chains remain protected.

incidents.summary: Repeated requests for already delivered sources prevented a large bar session from settling.
incidents.expected: Session delivery retains exact earlier-turn credit and verified excerpts; repeated requests settle without redelivering the union and the final bar becomes recordable.

incidents.summary: An openness reviewer required withheld texts but the native review had no continuation path.
incidents.expected: Oversized openness enters a bounded reading chain with delivered and remaining units; its final remains pending until required reading coverage completes.

incidents.summary: An oversized Codex input reached the CLI and was misreported as a decoding failure.
incidents.expected: Preflight measures the actual request and raises review_input_too_large before runtime probing or CLI dispatch; no paid call occurs.

incidents.summary: A renamed helper left historical readiness reconstruction calling a missing attribute.
incidents.expected: Historical bundles resolve their retained input exports through the current helper; exact historical readiness rebuilds while changed pin-time dependencies refuse.

incidents.summary: A CPU optimization increased peak memory on a large study store without proving its cause.
incidents.expected: Chunked JSON validation bounds buffers on synthetic records, but peak memory on the idle study store remains unqualified and the larger incident stays open.

incidents.summary: Some file-writing commands lacked check mode or could publish derivatives during inspection.
incidents.expected: Every writing parser accepts --check and unsupported preparation refuses explicitly; a check preserves workspace bytes even when ordinary packet preparation publishes derivatives.

incidents.summary: Descriptor deduplication made binary result delivery depend on media-alias order.
incidents.expected: Both generic and typed descriptors retain correct native bytes in either order; text-only routes mark both omitted without false attachment credit.

incidents.summary: A packet that fit the route bypassed the per-turn full-text reading budget.
incidents.expected: The reading budget is checked independently of total packet fit; a three-source oversized reading load enters a chain before dispatch and completes within its turn allowance.

incidents.summary: Check mode refused fresh-store initialization even though the corresponding write succeeded.
incidents.expected: The documented limit remains: check refuses with migration_required without creating a store; successful write initialization is not inferred from this refusal.

incidents.summary: Readiness recording rejected the documented author-memory disclosure field.
incidents.expected: Readiness accepts and preserves true, false and legacy absence through check, write and replay; invalid assessor shapes remain typed input refusals.

incidents.summary: Malformed reconciliation input caused a traceback instead of a structured refusal.
incidents.expected: CLI payload validation emits structured invalid_input or the supported check-mode refusal; no traceback or unintended mutation is required to reject the payload.

incidents.summary: The draft-marker recovery instruction failed on symbolic links and existing markers.
incidents.expected: Recovery moves an unrecorded marker aside before bootstrapping; unsafe adoption remains refused and external symlink targets stay untouched.

incidents.summary: A Codex capacity error was recorded as an undifferentiated JSON decoding failure.
incidents.expected: Retained provider diagnostics distinguish server overload from malformed output; capacity failures wait with durable bounded backoff and eventually stop as review_provider_unavailable without restarting the allowance.

incidents.summary: A large openness turn exceeded the amount of new full text it could read in time.
incidents.expected: Reading plans split the measured source sizes within the per-turn character budget; delivered spans cover each source exactly and a bounded final records complete coverage.

incidents.summary: A failed reading continuation could not fork safely from its original parent.
incidents.expected: A replacement uses the failed turn's original parent and slot; the replaced assignment can neither run nor continue and the valid replacement can record a final.

incidents.summary: Older openness chains replayed notes and records until their final exceeded Codex capacity.
incidents.expected: A KMP-shaped legacy chain continues under its historical contract with compacted replay and retained excerpts; every request fits and the final openness review records.

incidents.summary: A native reviewer returned a truncated claim digest and the caller overlooked its recorded output refusal.
incidents.expected: Run-time native validation retains the wrong-digest output as an invalid_native_review refusal; the caller must inspect output_refusal before binding, and no invalid claim digest receives acceptance credit.

incidents.summary: Lab execution tools failed to find admitted computations in problem workspaces.
incidents.expected: The lab CLI discovers the problem store, runs one admitted computation and reconciles its recorded result; assessment validates without adding a study marker or duplicate execution.

incidents.summary: A completed reviewer response could remain pending when its finishing write stayed busy.
incidents.expected: Bounded same-process retry preserves a response and avoids a second model call when contention clears; recovery after persistent finishing-write failure remains an open pending-state limit.

incidents.summary: A passage-anchor refusal omitted the request and rule needed to correct the output.
incidents.expected: The refusal names its request, JSON path and normalized minimum length; one corrected retry can continue while the refused output remains authenticated and retained.

incidents.summary: A route pinned to an older runtime could not dispatch under the installed adapter.
incidents.expected: Activation reports the wrapper, executable and route mismatch before dispatch; recording and probing a compatible route is an explicit handoff and old attempts continue authenticating under their pins.

incidents.summary: A release merged without the required tag and release record.
incidents.expected: The release procedure creates the missing version tag and explicit non-latest release record; publication remains an external release step rather than a harness mutation.

incidents.summary: Shipped texts and examples described unsupported commands or wrong visual evidence.
incidents.expected: The corrected visual example acquires its referenced image under the real locator contract; unrelated text corrections have no behavior proof in this test.

incidents.summary: Openness export accepted a search that did not address its formulation.
incidents.expected: Export refuses openness_statement_mismatch before writing artifacts or starting review; the refusal identifies the formulation and exact bound search.

incidents.summary: CLI results omitted execution ids, output descriptors and the literature digest needed by later steps.
incidents.expected: Run and reconcile print the recorded execution id and outputs while status exposes the compared literature digest; receipt replay stays identical and stale digests refuse.

incidents.summary: HTML visual acquisition could not establish completeness for styled pages.
incidents.expected: The documented styled-page limit remains partial with explicit unsupported-style diagnostics; direct image inspection does not establish complete page delivery.

incidents.summary: Research outputs did not clearly separate intermediate review work from selected final results.
incidents.expected: View rendering places intermediate records and turn outputs under intermediate and current selected results under final; immutable store records keep their original authentication.

incidents.summary: A local acceptance check skipped during CI discovery and made the shard fail despite no failing test.
incidents.expected: The local stored-record acceptance check lives outside unittest discovery; CI executes portable tests without that environment-dependent skip, while the shard runner still rejects any skipped discovered test.

incidents.summary: Argparse wrapped publication help text so an existing citation-check assertion no longer matched.
incidents.expected: Help rendering preserves the tested citation-check phrase across both publication commands; the existing help test passes instead of failing on an argparse line break.

incidents.summary: An unidentified process replaced the plugin cache and configuration while running Codex sessions still needed the older hooks.
incidents.expected: Each generated hook command finds its entrypoint missing: a blocking hook refuses with the update message, a non-blocking hook reports it, and the Stop hook lets the session stop; the session restarts to load the new version (owner decision of 0.62.0).

incidents.summary: Unreviewed release guidance included a deposit step that rebuilt an already pinned archive and failed its managed publication contract.
incidents.expected: Corrected deposit guidance reuses the exact source archive pinned by the write stage, and reviewed math and AI Science texts follow the shipped contracts; valid managed deposit proceeds without an unintended direct-path fallback, with no named behavior test for these text corrections.

incidents.summary: The math guard rejected permitted compound read-only commands and environment-prefixed invocations.
incidents.expected: Literal environment prefixes, understood read-only command lists and du are accepted without weakening protected writes, unsupported-command refusals, path-length handling or permission errors.

incidents.summary: Record packets retained absolute attack roots and could not be verified after relocation.
incidents.expected: General packet relocation remains open; record qualification instead runs clone-local read-only search status and next without verifying relocated packets or following live registry paths.

incidents.summary: Large reviewer turns overflowed the output cap and were repeatedly eligible to run again.
incidents.expected: The failure planner adapts only when a smaller admissible request is demonstrated; otherwise it stops as review_output_over_cap, or review_parts_budget_exhausted at the card-floor allowance, before another call.

incidents.summary: Complete result evidence exceeded the route limit even after ordinary fitting.
incidents.expected: Part delivery sends a longest fitting prefix with explicit remaining units; every part and final fits and the recorded final audits complete series coverage.

incidents.summary: A reviewer cited a historical record with two digest characters transposed.
incidents.expected: Delivery validation retains review_evidence_undelivered for the wrong digest; the suggested richer diagnostic remains unimplemented and no false evidence credit is granted.

incidents.summary: Planning one review rebuilt hundreds of earlier requests thousands of times.
incidents.expected: One command evaluation shares attempt inventory and request derivations while preserving revision order; results remain equal without command-spanning mutable state.

incidents.summary: An indivisible computation unit repeated large owned bodies across parts.
incidents.expected: Units retain owned-body identity and deliver each body once with earlier-turn credit; a fitting series progresses without splitting scientific passages.

incidents.summary: Repeated objection evidence made the final too large and could lose required bodies.
incidents.expected: The final deduplicates shared entries without losing their resolution mapping and requires every distinct body to be delivered; only a complete fitting final records.

incidents.summary: A digestless copy made a uniquely delivered record digest look ambiguous.
incidents.expected: A single known digest resolves consistently regardless of digestless-copy order; conflicting known versions still produce an evidence refusal.

incidents.summary: Running app servers kept the installed plugin cache behind the released version.
incidents.expected: Kept by decision: a running session keeps the plugin version it loaded; the cache is updated when no session that loaded it runs, and a session restarts to load a new version (activation procedure of 0.73.0).

incidents.summary: Part review quality had not been measured against equivalent single-input reviews.
incidents.expected: The paid quality measurement and real model-call demonstration remain pending; staged reviews stay blocked by review_quality_measurement_pending and cannot post.

incidents.summary: The citation export listed an arXiv work twice through its DataCite DOI alias.
incidents.expected: Citation projection merges justified arXiv-DOI registry pairs while preserving distinct related works; an already posted citation list remains immutable.

incidents.summary: Successive bibliography patches missed directive and identifier grammar shapes.
incidents.expected: The supported bibliography reader excludes directive bodies and preserves exact work identities; three documented directive forms remain known open limits rather than certified coverage.

incidents.summary: Text priority selected a pending raw TeX capture instead of an available PDF extraction.
incidents.expected: Selection skips unavailable text captures and chooses the complete extracted PDF; openness export succeeds without a NoneType traceback.

incidents.summary: A reviewer closed its JSON object early and continued writing top-level fields.
incidents.expected: For a new completed answer with one lossless reading, certified premature-root-close recovery preserves every member and value and completes without another call; ambiguous duplicate-key shapes remain refused.

incidents.summary: A URL-only manuscript was cited by its path without authors or a useful title.
incidents.expected: Evidence-backed citation metadata supplies title, authors and year without changing work, reading or locator identity; the corrected citation and provenance reach review projection.

incidents.summary: A new record kind and command were absent from output-view and check-mode registries.
incidents.expected: Every writing command preserves its workspace in check mode and every written record kind has a placement; the two registry checks accept the extended contract.

incidents.summary: Repeated result refreshes retained all prior assistant outputs until the final could not fit.
incidents.expected: Historical part-output compaction preserves required science and exact recorded requests; the current final fits and prior series remain retained rather than rewritten.

incidents.summary: Large staged review preparation performed quadratic issue scans and exceeded its supported scale.
incidents.expected: Scale preflight refuses review_staged_scale_unsupported before freezing, planning or writing; issue deduplication avoids accumulated-list scans and the store stays unchanged.

incidents.summary: A final review could not cite a reading delivered by an earlier series of the same slot.
incidents.expected: Actual delivery collection includes the eligible earlier series across restarts; its exact reading citation records and audits without duplicate delivery or false coverage.

incidents.summary: A final review added an unsupported assurances_note field.
incidents.expected: The strict output contract records invalid_value_review; one bounded resample can recover while both the original answer and refusal stay retained.

incidents.summary: History compaction kept abandoned series verbatim and prevented a later final from fitting.
incidents.expected: Compaction includes superseded part series with explicit historical markers; the current series can finish while original stored observations remain unchanged.

incidents.summary: Focused adjudication lacked part delivery for evidence above its route limit.
incidents.expected: Oversized focused adjudication enters the role's parts contract and retains focused identity; fitting packets keep their single-call contract and accepted finals become ready.

incidents.summary: Automatic staged entry created review slots whose quality gate had no passing issuer.
incidents.expected: New oversized result entry uses the supported parts path rather than automatic staged review; existing staged slots remain blocked by review_quality_measurement_pending.

incidents.summary: CI discovery exposed conflicting tests packages and subprocess startup assumptions.
incidents.expected: Fixture imports and subprocess paths are isolated and process cleanup waits on observed state; CI executes the same portable tests without inheriting a different tests package.

incidents.summary: Undelivered objection-evidence bodies made the final too large after all ordinary evidence parts had finished.
incidents.expected: When a final cannot fit with required undelivered objection bodies, a body-only part delivers a fitting prefix and records new delivery progress; the following final reuses authenticated current-series body credit, attaches remaining required evidence and records its citations without exceeding the route limit.

incidents.summary: A store-preparation test read its child marker before the child wrote it.
incidents.expected: The test waits for the child marker before reading; the observed receipt and preparation checks complete without a timing-dependent missing file.

incidents.summary: A reader mistook a just-unlinked rollback journal for a forbidden SQLite alias.
incidents.expected: Snapshot checking treats a zero-link journal as absent after revalidation; the reader returns the committed snapshot instead of unsafe_path.

incidents.summary: Repeated writer commits exhausted the reader's bounded journal rechecks.
incidents.expected: Zero-link journals are classified absent rather than retried as aliases; the existing storage reproduction accepts the committed snapshot under the corrected rule.

incidents.summary: DOI full-text jobs refused valid publisher redirects without an observed exact-version identifier.
incidents.expected: A complete publisher response for a DOI retains requested identity and honest absent observed identity; the job completes with exact original and extracted bytes.

incidents.summary: The plugin cache remained old while long-running Codex sessions held its hooks.
incidents.expected: Kept by decision: a running session keeps the plugin version it loaded; the cache is updated when no session that loaded it runs, and a session restarts to load a new version (activation procedure of 0.73.0).

incidents.summary: A heredoc body was mistaken for a path component longer than the filesystem permits.
incidents.expected: An ENAMETOOLONG shell-text probe is treated as an absent candidate path; the valid heredoc command passes without weakening permission-error denials.

incidents.summary: Python 3.14 path predicates hid permission errors and caused guards to allow protected operations.
incidents.expected: File-status probes use stat to distinguish absence from unreadability; permission failures propagate into a denial on every supported Python.

incidents.summary: An abstract request for a DOI-only work stayed pending despite evidence of unavailability.
incidents.expected: Qualified unavailability can settle the retrieval request without scientific credit, but alias-abstract reuse and publisher-import completeness remain deferred and open.

incidents.summary: Early closure or surplus braces made complete reviewer answers fail JSON decoding.
incidents.expected: New completed responses with a single permitted reading recover with an authenticated certificate, preserved raw text and no extra call; duplicate keys or competing answers remain malformed and old failed observations are unchanged.

incidents.summary: A running Claude session kept using old hooks after the plugin cache was updated.
incidents.expected: Kept by decision: a running session keeps the plugin version it loaded; the cache is updated when no session that loaded it runs, and a session restarts to load a new version (activation procedure of 0.73.0).

incidents.summary: Math root discovery still raised ENAMETOOLONG after another hook had been fixed.
incidents.expected: The shared file-status reader treats an overlong component or whole path as absent while retaining PermissionError; root discovery and valid writes avoid false recovery refusals.

incidents.summary: An openness chain repeatedly delivered the same disposition lists across many search records.
incidents.expected: The v5 chain shares identical whole disposition fields while retaining all fifteen original search receipts; synthetic measured-shape coverage completes, but live efficacy measurement stays pending.

incidents.summary: Selected full texts and retained excerpts made the final impossible only after many paid turns.
incidents.expected: Earlier-turn delivery credit allows selected text omission while preserving native proof bytes; headroom diagnostics appear before invocation and the measured-count final fits with complete coverage.

incidents.summary: An existing prompt test omitted the newly supported openness protocol.
incidents.expected: The test's expected protocol set includes the supported version; current prompts still state the per-turn budget and historical contracts retain their versions.

incidents.summary: Post-gate evaluation repeatedly derived the same large review requests.
incidents.expected: A command evaluation reuses pure request derivations within its retention budget and returns isolated mutable values; parity stays exact and duplicate construction is bounded.

incidents.summary: Problem status ignored requested diagnostic counters after an early return.
incidents.expected: Status with counters exposes evaluation time and retention diagnostics; removing those diagnostics yields the same ordinary report without changing store state.

incidents.summary: Memo keys consumed iterator history and conflated list and tuple fitting orders.
incidents.expected: Iterator history bypasses retained request caching and fitting-order types remain distinct; each derivation preserves the actual supplied history and native fitting semantics.

incidents.summary: Memoized derivation passed an unsupported order keyword to existing four-argument request builders.
incidents.expected: Default-order derivation uses the compatible four positional arguments and explicit historical orders retain identity; request construction and authentication reproduce the pinned request.

incidents.summary: A staged worker launch made a paged direction-review test fail once with store_busy.
incidents.expected: Polling treats store_busy as not-yet until its original deadline and retains the admitted reservation; resumption uses the same request and never launches a second worker.

incidents.summary: A parts-v1 series without a final exhausted replay capacity and had no path to parts v2.
incidents.expected: After either v1 planner refusal and its existing reduction, one atomic prospective v2 successor starts with empty delivery credit and bounded search bodies; historical v1 evidence stays unchanged and the active chain can finish or return a typed stop.

incidents.summary: Codex calls failed without retaining an answer or an actionable provider reason.
incidents.expected: For new calls, retained rollout diagnostics identify usage or capacity conditions; an unknown no-answer failure waits only when cheap, with durable backoff and a seven-provider-failure or eight-total-failure stop across restarts and replacements.

incidents.class: Early close of the answer object
incidents.summary: An answer closed its root object before appending more top-level fields.
incidents.expected: A new completed response with a nonempty id and exactly one lossless reading is certified as premature_root_close; the original response is retained, observation completes without another model call, and historical failures remain unchanged.

incidents.class: Early close that repeats a key
incidents.summary: Joining an early-closed answer would produce duplicate decoded member names.
incidents.expected: Recovery refuses duplicate member names at every depth; the answer remains answer_malformed, receives at most one further call at the turn position, then stops without discarding the original response.

incidents.summary: One complete answer object was followed only by extra closing braces and whitespace.
incidents.expected: A new completed response recovers as surplus_closing_braces with removed offsets and canonical digests; authentication replays the certificate, the original answer stays retained and no extra model call is made.

incidents.class: Raw control character in a string
incidents.summary: An otherwise valid answer object contained a literal control character inside a JSON string.
incidents.expected: The certified recovery grammar preserves literal control characters and every decoded value, alone or with a permitted brace rule; the observation completes without another call and historical failed observations remain failed.

incidents.summary: An answer had a missing comma or additional fence and prose with no permitted recovery.
incidents.expected: The full-input recovery refuses competing or unsupported readings as answer_malformed; one retry is allowed across the whole turn position and the second failure stops with its evidence retained.

incidents.summary: A provider returned a usage-limit message instead of review output.
incidents.expected: The planner waits until the stated reset with its timezone, or uses durable one-to-thirty-minute backoff when absent; it makes no call during the wait and eventually stops as review_provider_unavailable under the stored allowance.

incidents.summary: Provider API errors included both unreachable-server messages and a safeguards refusal.
incidents.expected: Unreachable API errors wait with durable bounded provider backoff; safeguards refusal gets one additional call and then review_provider_refused, with the total eight-failure allowance and original observations preserved.

incidents.summary: Large answers exceeded their output allowance and could not be used.
incidents.expected: Only an existing handler proving a smaller admissible request may adapt; reading and native overflows otherwise stop as review_output_over_cap, and a parts read at its minimum card-floor allowance stops as review_parts_budget_exhausted before another call.

incidents.class: Input over the route limit at run time
incidents.summary: The transport refused oversized input before making a reviewer call.
incidents.expected: Preflight makes no model call; an eligible initial-size replacement is planned from the original parent, otherwise the chain stops with input_over_limit and its measured refusal.

incidents.summary: A transient CLI version-check failure prevented a review call from starting.
incidents.expected: Every pre-dispatch runtime check retries after one, two, four, eight and sixteen seconds; an exhausted post-admission failure is captured and finished as runtime_unavailable, then stops without duplicate generation or a stranded pending call.

incidents.summary: Other failed attempts included an unsupported format and an attempt with no recorded error.
incidents.expected: Unsupported dispatch format stops without a model call; an unclassifiable attempt stays unknown, and only a cheap Codex failure without an answer can enter the bounded provider wait schedule.

incidents.summary: Reading-chain answers violated the reading-response contract.
incidents.expected: The completed answer retains an output refusal with code invalid_reading_response; one further scientific call is allowed, and after two refusals the chain hands off for an authorized output correction or explicit repair, preserving both attempts and refusing an unbounded third call.

incidents.summary: Completed answers violated the value-review contract.
incidents.expected: The completed answer retains an output refusal with code invalid_value_review; one further scientific call is allowed, and after two refusals the chain hands off for an authorized output correction or explicit repair, preserving both attempts and refusing an unbounded third call.

incidents.summary: A reassessment labelled changed inherited content as an exact confirmation.
incidents.expected: The completed answer retains an output refusal with code review_reassessment_mismatch; one further scientific call is allowed, and after two refusals the chain hands off for an authorized output correction or explicit repair, preserving both attempts and refusing an unbounded third call.

incidents.summary: An answer reused an objection identity for another contested claim.

incidents.expected: problem-post-external records the post with gate bypassed, the reason and the evidence; the store becomes terminal; a second post of the statement is refused.

incidents.summary: A result turn that failed with review_runtime_missing had no obligation in status and nothing in next (graph rigidity slot A turn 7).
incidents.expected: Every chain head without a usable output is listed with its planned action; a runtime failure, never charged, is retried on the provider schedule and an attempt recorded before 0.73.0 runs at once.

incidents.summary: A completed Claude answer stating that the response exceeded the 20000 output token maximum read as a provider condition, so the schedule would repeat the same over-cap request.

incidents.summary: Failed native reviews that later reviews superseded would have been listed in status as calls to run.
incidents.expected: status adds no obligation for a failed native mathematical head unless it is an openness chain; plan_next and review-series still plan every head.

incidents.summary: Executable actions attached before the gate digest made the digest change between two reads of an unchanged store.
incidents.expected: Actions are attached after every report digest; two reads of an unchanged store give the same digest, equal to the digest without actions.

incidents.summary: review-assignment --check and problem-posted --check refused with check_unsupported on a local reviewer route, because reading the reviewer CLI version and verifying the recorded context counted as external effects (bunkbed copy, 0.72.4).
incidents.expected: Reading the reviewer CLI version and verifying recorded context are local reads that check mode and the record check permit; review-assignment --check plans a turn on every local route and writes nothing, while model calls, network access and writes stay refused.

incidents.summary: One status on the bunkbed copy read 10,170 artifacts, parsed 12,598 packets and rebuilt 1,431 requests, because the readers of one command repeated the same derivations.
incidents.expected: Within one command, verified artifact parses and series derivations are reused through the bounded evaluation arena; each artifact is parsed once and each selected turn and paged history is materialized once, with outputs unchanged.

incidents.summary: Recorded ordinary text requests were fully materialized after every pinned reduction and source-capacity trial; superseded route-probe authentication added report cost. Predicate reuse through fresh verification namespaces increased verified work instead of saving it.
incidents.expected: Reconstruct supported recorded text requests with exact nested JSON character lengths and one final materialization per fit-order candidate. Preserve all five fit orders, request bytes, whole-source selection, first observed binding, refusal order and complete reports. Keep provenance and refusal classification on the caller's verified evaluation without additional predicate caches or verification namespaces; authenticate the last metadata-matching probe. No evaluation counter increases against the native path. Exhaustive record-check reconstruction and protected module bytes stay unchanged.

incidents.summary: The math-solver registry of a record copy names live absolute paths, so a reader of the copy that follows it reads or writes the live record.
incidents.expected: The record check finds math-solver roots on disk inside the clone, never reads or follows the registry, and runs search status and search next with --attack-root set to each cloned root.

incidents.summary: Records stayed on old versions because none could show that a newer version was safe for it, and the version a record ran was held in its own wrappers.
incidents.expected: record-check qualifies a copy of a record with a version before the record moves to it, and reports the harness version, path and Python it ran with, so a run through the record's wrapper shows the version that the wrapper runs.

incidents.summary: The first record check of the candidate failed status on the unknotting copy with KeyError('native'): the obligation annotation read the stored packet of a native head instead of its native packet.
incidents.expected: Native heads load their packet through native_review.load_packet from the assignment's native packet reference; status annotates their obligations without a crash.

incidents.summary: On the graph rigidity and bunkbed copies, plan_next planned record for an openness final (decision revise) that problem-openness refuses, so the planned step could never succeed.
incidents.expected: record is planned only for an output that problem-openness accepts by its own checks; any other final is the handoff openness_review_not_approved (export, kind problem-openness) with the decision, the reason and the refusal.

incidents.summary: After two refused outputs, a native mathematical review that is not an openness chain was handed off with a plain new assignment, which needs a new attestation from the controller.
incidents.expected: The review_slot_exhausted handoff of such a head names search review-packet, as native_review_attestation_required does.

incidents.summary: The reconstruction of a visual request on the extremal copy needed PDF page rendering, which check mode refused as an external effect.
incidents.expected: The visual manifest and preparation request the local read pdf_render; the record check permits only the pinned renderer, keeps its temporary files inside the clone and lists the read.

incidents.summary: The sandbox denied writes to /dev/null, breaking Codex runtime reads and disabling optional state-memo reuse. On a mixed Claude/Codex record copy, status took 45.3 seconds with 127 route context verifications outside isolation, versus 370.6 seconds with 6,961 inside it; continuation runtime reads could also raise PermissionError.
incidents.expected: A literal /dev/null exemption lets isolated subprocesses use DEVNULL, so Codex runtime reads can compute the state-memo identity and qualification can continue. Every other write outside the clone and report directory, every source-workspace read, and outbound network remain denied.

incidents.summary: Both bunkbed copies failed the continuation step at assign-openness-4-t18, whose mandatory final input (1,303,063 characters) is over the route limit of 1,300,000, although the next step is a decision on the route or the material.
incidents.expected: review_input_too_large in the phase final_preflight and the three parts planning refusals of an allowed action are decision stops listed with their head, command, code and details; every other refusal keeps its result.

incidents.summary: The integrity step failed with invalid_input on publication.scope history containing workspace projections with media_type, path, projection and sha256 but no size. A shape scan of 1,144 events collected 833,185 references, including 214,020 such descriptors in payload, changes and result; these describe workspace files or folders rather than stored artifacts.
incidents.expected: Integrity verifies only references under the artifact store's object or sealed directory. Other descriptors are counted once per distinct descriptor in workspace_descriptors without reading them, alongside the verified artifact count. A workspace projection without size passes; a store reference without size still fails with invalid_input, and damaged stored bytes still fail with artifact_corrupt.

incidents.summary: On a copy of a live deposited study under load, status, next and obligations took 1392, 1333 and 1311 s under 0.72.4 and 1344, 1331 and 1303 s under 0.73.0. Each reader stopped at record-check's 900 s ceiling with record_command_timeout, failing the report step although the readers work.
incidents.expected: The default ceiling is 3600 s per report or math-solver reader, defined once by record_check.DEFAULT_TIME_BUDGET_SECONDS and used by the CLI parser. The measured reader durations pass within that default; explicit overrides, finite positive validation and timeout failures remain unchanged. The release procedure still compares reader times with the previous release to detect regressions.

incidents.summary: An external post recorded many hours after publication reported its recording time as the post time.
incidents.expected: A supplied server timestamp stays verbatim beside a separate UTC recording time; omission is null, legacy status normalizes a copy, and old records, receipts, fingerprints and raw exports stay unchanged.

incidents.summary: An older external post had no structured way to retain its known server creation time after correcting the interpretation of its stored timestamp.
incidents.expected: One immutable time statement for an eligible older external post supplies the status time with verified evidence and a separate export; exact requests replay before eligibility, with no change to scientific evidence, gates or request reconstruction.

incidents.summary: A valid focused adjudication stopped resolving its objection while both current result successors were pending because the assessment omitted the evidence digest.
incidents.expected: The current digest is computed even with an empty pair; adjudications bound to that digest and material version retain effect, stale bindings remain unresolved, and the missing or pending pair still blocks posting.

incidents.summary: Ordinary and parts v1 successors occupied result slots but the report described an absent pair; newer parts omitted the missing independent slot beside a pending head.
incidents.expected: Every current result head contributes occupancy; pending work stays in its series, a genuinely absent independent slot retains the pair finding, completed peers are checked, complete report shapes are preserved, and next continues the pending series.

incidents.summary: Refreshing one or both result slots retired the finals that had resolved historical objections, leaving those objections open while successor work continued.
incidents.expected: Superseded finals retain their historical evidence but do not supply current resolutions; current finals or a valid focused adjudication resolve retained objections, explicit and saved old pairs remain refused, and external posting preserves the findings in after_post.

incidents.summary: Every CI test job installed Lean without retries, including the 12 general shards that do not use it. In 200 runs from 2026-10-24 to 2026-11-05, installer HTTP 504 or connection failures and toolchain HTTP 504, TLS or stalled downloads failed 18 jobs in 15 runs before any tests ran, also failing their Python summary jobs.
incidents.expected: Only jobs that run Lean install it. They restore and probe the pinned smoke fixture installation or install it with bounded, timed attempts that terminate stalled process groups. Incomplete toolchain directories and partial downloads are removed before every attempt, and failed probes trigger a fresh install. The cache is optional and saved only after installation and the fixture build succeed. Persistent installation failures and any harness test skip still fail the job.

incidents.summary: Posted two-slot parts findings retain continuation hints.
incidents.expected: Advisory projection removes only next; findings, counts and terminal behavior remain intact.

incidents.summary: A posted statement accepts fresh review, repair or adjudication assignments.
incidents.expected: Matching subjects receive problem_already_posted; replay, exclusions and second-post assignments remain valid.

incidents.summary: Existing assignments and reservations can start further calls after posting.
incidents.expected: New ordinary and staged calls stop; capture acceptance and reconciliation remain available.

incidents.summary: A posted controller can plan and assign another task.
incidents.expected: Frontier and direct-child creation refuse using the controller subject, including diagnostic preparation.

incidents.summary: A posted result can spend another correction call.
incidents.expected: Fresh correction refuses; historical correction authentication, replay and fingerprints remain unchanged.

incidents.summary: Status task progress and generated series files expose independent review instructions.
incidents.expected: Derived views retain evidence and progress without prospective review hints for posted subjects.

incidents.summary: Record-wide publication closure finished independent statement and solver review heads, while subject-only closure reopened posted native openness and old unbound chains.
incidents.expected: Classify the resolved head by its verified statement or native openness digest, or by the authenticated post revision after an unbound chain root; preserve independent work, supersession, preflight and handoff boundaries.

incidents.summary: A null-statement ancestor resolving to a posted head retained stale workflow and scope fields.
incidents.expected: Review hints use the resolved head's post state and retain evidence labels without prospective navigation or actions.

incidents.summary: Native problem-openness reviews without assignment subjects invited sixth calls, retired-route repairs and prospective preflight after publication.
incidents.expected: Validate the native openness packet and close its exact posted claim regardless of assignment age; remove new-work hints and refuse calls or continuations while retaining captured evidence and independent native solver work.

incidents.summary: Unbound publication reviews reopened through newer heads, staged children or replacements retaining a pre-publication slot.
incidents.expected: Close truly unbound publication reviews when a post follows the earliest assignment of their actual same-phase lineage and retained slot; normalize staged children to controllers and reject malformed ancestry without blocking a new independent slot.

incidents.summary: Normal posts lacked a recorded revision needed to close pre-publication unbound review chains.
incidents.expected: Recover post creation revisions only from authenticated events, retain the small index through snapshots and preparations, stamp new normal posts, and preserve historical record, event and receipt bytes while tracking concurrent publication.

incidents.summary: Publication closure and head selection validated bindings and ancestry even without a post, refusing unposted legacy reviews.
incidents.expected: Read post membership first and return without binding, packet or ancestry validation while no post exists; retain released legacy head selection, planning and authenticated call admission, while a concurrent post still invalidates admission.

incidents.summary: One posted status report repeatedly walked the same assignment lineage while classifying and decorating review hints.
incidents.expected: Within each status call reuse a successful closure root only for the exact records view and closure binding; discard the local memo on return or error, restore nested status scopes, and keep statement, native packet and ancestry validation intact.

incidents.summary: A graph problem was posted on the server without its local terminal post record.
incidents.expected: The existing external-post operation records the exact statement with details, saved server evidence and server time without an export, replays without writes and refuses duplicate publication and new review work.

incidents.summary: Qualified unavailability settled a source request using binary evidence that a text-only route could not deliver.
incidents.expected: Required qualification evidence must be deliverable before settlement; binary evidence stays pending on text-only routes, while capable routes and JSON qualifications retain settlement without scientific credit.

incidents.summary: A valid raw proof artifact digest supplied at the manifest boundary was reported as a corrupt manifest.
incidents.expected: A valid artifact where a manifest is required gives evidence_manifest_required without mutation; genuinely missing or corrupt blobs retain their errors and valid manifests retain their audits.

incidents.summary: The base verification prompt omitted executable stance, prediction-band and sampled-binding rules.

incidents.summary: Main caches could be evicted during idle periods because Lean CI ran only on pushes and pull requests.
incidents.expected: Daily and manual default-branch maintenance restores the CI cache identity, runs the bounded installer and real smoke build, and saves only after success. Cache operations are optional and timed; installation and compilation remain mandatory.

incidents.summary: Untargeted cohort readings repeatedly built a payload-sized bundle index that exceeded the evaluation arena.

incidents.expected: Discover every donor with provenance, validation failures and competing identities. Existing same_work aliases never establish exact version equivalence, so cross-identity abstracts remain alternatives, qualified absence keeps no scientific credit, exact requested captures still deliver, and saved assignments replay unchanged.

incidents.summary: Generic publisher excerpts could not establish complete abstract boundaries.
incidents.expected: An explicitly selected springer-meta-json-v1 parser admits a single exact DOI abstract only from a complete captured HTTP response with unambiguous JSON boundaries. The positive fixture is synthetic from documented format, not an original publisher capture. Old mapped imports remain partial and old receipts replay unchanged.

incidents.summary: Changed plugin scripts and expanded cache paths invalidate Codex hook trust after each update.
incidents.expected: Administrator-managed registrations pin the stable dispatcher outside the plugin cache and preserve every matcher and timeout. The smoke driver checks actual hooks/list and executes all managed commands; real Codex 0.163.0 scheduling acceptance remains the supervisor's deployment check.

incidents.summary: Deleting a plugin cache removes code and resources still used by a running session.
incidents.expected: A session retains its approved immutable release, CLI, skills and documents after a new default is published and its source cache deleted. Bindings live in private user state outside the administrator prefix. Publication and startup verify all payload hashes; later events check approval, the manifest and entrypoints without rehashing payloads. Invalid bindings and unavailable state retain event-specific refusal, and referenced bundles cannot be removed.

incidents.summary: Snapshot replay serializes full events, receipts and current rows again after their event components have already passed canonical validation.
incidents.expected: Replay reuses validated canonical segments for event hashing and receipt comparison and decodes projection-equal current rows without another encoding, removing two encodes per event and one per current row while preserving snapshots, histories, corruption errors and bounded UTF-8 buffers.

incidents.summary: A constructive strategy invalidated its entry condition by making its required first mode change.
incidents.expected: A versioned entry basis binds the exact claim; an active constructive strategy may continue through replan and observed reassessment after its own mode move. New construction entries and changed claims remain ineligible, a stale plan blocks the next move until replanning, and the strategy ends with fail; an entry signal on a move does not end it.
